_provenance: Second floor of Example8.floorplan (the .floorplan project the PNG was extracted from). Every figure below is read off the drawing's own wall faces, not off a detector run: the exterior faces from the first/last dark pixel on each scan line, the room faces from the ink runs crossing each room.

scale.provenance: Four independent hand measurements of a printed dimension against the wall faces it spans: LAUNDRY 6'5" over x=244-353 (16.99), BEDROOM-left 12'1" over x=30-234 (16.97), BEDROOM-right 12'2" over x=363-570 (17.10) and 12'5" over y=35-245 (16.99).

rooms.name: LAUNDRY
rooms._comment: A closet with bi-fold doors: its south side is drawn as two door arcs, so the bottom edge is the one the label places rather than one the ink states.

rooms.name: BEDROOM (right)
rooms._comment: The printed width includes the bay: 363-570 is 17.01 px/ft against 12'2", where stopping at the main east wall (536) would imply 14.2.
